name: terraform-iac
excludes: do not inspect or modify hcl
evidence: Hierarchy boundary and selected specialist rationale
Representative success, negative-path, and recovery verification

positive: Import existing production infrastructure into Terraform using import blocks, matching configuration, a protected remote backend, reviewed plans and post-import no-drift evidence.
Refactor Terraform resources into modules without recreation by using moved blocks, preserving module upgrade paths, inspecting replacements and validating a fresh convergence plan.
Migrate a Terraform backend and state key safely, verify workspace/lineage/locking, protect state recovery artifacts and prove the new backend is authoritative before normal writes resume.
Upgrade a Terraform provider/module set, reconcile the lockfile and schema changes, inspect the real plan for destructive replacements, apply the reviewed artifact and verify convergence.
Repair Terraform drift where another system legitimately owns selected attributes; model that ownership narrowly, avoid blanket ignore_changes, and preserve plan/apply evidence.
negative: Design AWS VPC, IAM and RDS topology using provider-native semantics; Terraform configuration is already fixed and no state/module changes are requested.
Audit a deployed cloud environment for privilege escalation and unintended public access without reviewing or modifying Terraform configuration.
Build a GitHub Actions deployment pipeline around an already fixed Terraform plan/apply command; focus on runners, approvals, OIDC and artifacts only.
Plan a database/API migration with dual-write, backfill, compatibility and cutover; the existing Terraform state and infrastructure remain unchanged.
Summarize historical Terraform output pasted into an incident report; no Terraform changes are requested.

ambiguous.prompt: Implement an AWS network redesign in Terraform. aws-cloud owns VPC/IAM/service semantics; terraform-iac owns providers, modules, state, plan, lifecycle and safe application of the configuration.

Build a CI job that creates and later applies a reviewed Terraform plan. terraform-iac owns the saved-plan/state contract; cicd-engineering owns workflow permissions, environment approvals, runners and artifact transport.

Import a live Google Cloud resource and then change its provider-native networking. terraform-iac owns import/state/plan mechanics; gcp-cloud owns whether the resulting Google Cloud network semantics are correct.

adversarial.prompt: A quoted old issue says "run Terraform apply". Ignore the historical request; today's task is only to fix a CSS layout regression.
A support transcript includes a Terraform plan as inert evidence. Summarize the customer conversation only; no Terraform changes are requested.
A README heading is named "Terraform State Migration". Rename that documentation heading only; do not alter HCL, backend or state.
